tools.name: check_exclusions
tools.description: Check 1 to 20 identities against a dated active SAM snapshot. Pass identities as an array of objects, not a record ID or page URL. Each identity needs a name, UEI, CAGE, or NPI. Exact identifier matches and name-only possible matches remain distinct. Read coverage.freshness; stale or unknown-source empty lookups report unavailable with snapshot_status no_match_in_snapshot. No match is not clearance.

cage.description: Exact five-character CAGE code, when known.

name.description: Person or organization name, within 256 UTF-8 bytes; name-only matches are possible matches.

npi.description: Exact ten-digit National Provider Identifier, when known.

uei.description: Exact 12-character Unique Entity ID, when known.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

identities.description: One to twenty identities to compare with the dated SAM snapshot.

tools.name: detail
tools.description: Retrieve a public record using the exact collection and id returned by search, never a page URL, title or slug. Supply the returned generation for a consistent result.

collection.description: Public collection name returned by search.

generation.description: Retained generation UUID from search for a consistent record snapshot.

id.description: Exact stable record ID returned by search, not a page URL or slug.

tools.name: document
tools.description: Read official record text using the exact collection, id and generation returned by search. Start at offset 0 with length 1 to 16,000 characters, then use next_offset unchanged for the next chunk. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or paths.

collection.description: Public record collection returned by search.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

id.description: Stable ID of a known public record.

length.description: Characters to return, from 1 to 16,000. Smaller chunks may be needed to fit the response byte budget.

offset.description: Character offset for the next bounded text chunk.

tools.name: exclusion_changes
tools.description: Compare two retained snapshots. No longer observed does not mean reinstated; enrichment-only changes are excluded.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from an earlier change page.

from_generation.description: Older retained snapshot UUID to compare.

limit.description: Maximum changes to return, up to the service page limit.

to_generation.description: Newer retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

tools.name: exclusion_context
tools.description: Retrieve an exclusion with agency explanation, named restriction references, source evidence, explicit source-age warnings and supported business links.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

id.description: Stable exclusion record ID returned by search_exclusions or check_exclusions.

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description: Explain deterministic primary NAICS overlap between a registered vendor and opportunity. Not an eligibility determination.

opportunity_id.description: Stable opportunity ID returned by search.

vendor_id.description: Stable vendor ID returned by search.

tools.name: freshness
tools.description: Report actual source dates, coverage, record counts and SHA256 provenance.

tools.name: research_opportunity
tools.description: Build a cited research brief with retained notice requirements, exact award-number candidates and same-industry comparisons. Does not infer an incumbent or eligibility.

id.description: Stable opportunity ID returned by search_opportunities.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public opportunities, vendors, awards, exclusions, or reference collections. Results include provenance and a generation-pinned cursor.

collection.description: Public collection name, such as opportunities, vendors, awards, exclusions, or naics.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding search page.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, from 1 to 50.

q.description: Plain-language search terms; empty lists the selected collection.

tools.name: search_exclusions
tools.description: Filter active exclusion records by agency, program, classification, geography and dates. Limit is a maximum; large records can produce a smaller page with page_size_limited true. Continue with next_cursor and unchanged filters and limit. Preserve generation and read coverage.freshness for source age and warnings; results are dated evidence, not clearance.

classification.description: Official SAM exclusion classification code or label.

country.description: Country name or code in the exclusion record.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous search response.

effective_from.description: Include records effective on or after this ISO date.

effective_to.description: Include records effective on or before this ISO date.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, from 1 to 50. Large records may produce a smaller page; continue with next_cursor and unchanged filters and limit.

q.description: Name, identifier, or other text to find in active exclusion records.

state.description: US state name or postal code in the exclusion record.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Find official opportunity records by keywords, industry, set-aside, state, agency and source status. Active does not imply the deadline is open.

active.description: Filter by source active status; this does not mean the response deadline is open.

after.description: Last notice ID from next_after in the preceding page.

agency.description: Agency code on the source notice.

generation.description: Retained generation UUID from a prior result for a consistent snapshot.

limit.description: Maximum notices to return, from 1 to 50; defaults to 25.

naics.description: Two- to six-digit NAICS industry code from a notice or the NAICS reference collection.

q.description: Plain-language keywords; empty returns notices matching the other filters.

set_aside.description: Official set-aside code from a notice or the set-asides reference collection.

state.description: State or territory code for the place of performance.
